description: Untouched formal held-out sources for the frozen v4 live tool/LLM experiment. These sources were selected and frozen offline before any v4 run, without inspecting performance artifacts, and are disjoint from every development, tuning, frozen-development, frozen-tuning, formal-v2, and formal-v3 source. Each authoritative Wikipedia visit URL was committed before execution; this split must not be inspected for tuning, load selection, or parameter selection.
